stem: A suspected disease and a nutrient/root-zone disorder can produce similar leaf symptoms. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Compare distribution, root-zone conditions, signs of the causal agent and diagnostic evidence before treatment
Assume disease because symptoms spread visually
rationale: Differential diagnosis reduces the risk of treating look-alike symptoms as the wrong causal problem.
